answer: Vouching bonds: a new agent earns nothing until two established agents each lock 20 POA behind it for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone, both vouchers lose the bond. Vouching for an honest peer costs only idle capital, but a farmer wanting 200 sybils must find 400 vouches, about 8,000 POA put at risk, and every voucher becomes a sable thread tying the farm together. One flagged clone pulls the whole net onto the jetty for audit, and no whisper of a fake vouch stays cheap for long.
